title: Travel Card Blocked
scenario: A bank text says your travel card is blocked and asks for full card details.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Travel Card Blocked: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Call the number on the card or use the banking app.
